Terraria 1.4.6: Crossplay Phase One Launches Today! 2026-11-27 12:00 UTC Good News, Terrarians! THE CROSSPLAY ERA FOR TERRARIA STARTS HERE This feature has been years in the making and we're so pleased to be able to release to you Phase One of Crossplay. Starting today, for most people using the same Wi-Fi/wired network you will be able to play together with any device which has v1.4.6 Terraria, without a multiplayer subscription.
